snippet.title: Weave & Wander – New Gameplay Features Showcase (Alpha)
snippet.description:
Hey guys!
My name is Matt, and I’m currently working on a cozy spider adventure game called Weave & Wander.

In this video, I’m showcasing the current state of the game, including the newly implemented day/night cycle, interaction system, dialogue system, and a small carrying/inventory mechanic.

The game is still in early alpha development, but I’m excited to share more updates here as development continues. Hope you enjoy it :)

W&W Steam Page (to be updated):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4532850/Weave__Wander/

Also checkout my Discord for more updates!
https://discord.gg/r267gf7Kg
